tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: Use first. Lists every sport this connector serves, with its leagues and tool count. Free.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Finds tools across every sport by keyword ("shot locations", "player props", "standings"). Pass sport when you know it; otherwise a sport, league or team named in the query narrows the search. Returns sport, tool, credits and a one-line summary. Free.

tools.name: describe_tool
tools.description: Full description, credits, leagues and input schema for one tool in one sport. Free.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Runs one tool for one sport with its arguments, exactly as that sport's own connector would, and costs that tool's credits (see describe_tool).
